source: Alpaca Market Data v1beta1 options snapshots, feed=indicative (paper account)
license: Alpaca market data terms; INDICATIVE feed — NOT consolidated NBBO; internal research use

field_map.feed: always 'indicative' — the honesty label travels with every record

confidence_model: quotes are INDICATIVE (single-source), never NBBO; Databento cbbo-1m (2013->present) is the ground-truth complement per the options-data decision 2026-07-04
day_label: file YYYY-MM-DD = the ET trading date of the session whose post-close quotes it holds (from 2026-10-27 fix). Files written before the fix were captured ~00:40 ET and hold the PREVIOUS session's close under the next date (audit 2026-10-27 §2.4 defect 1) — use each record's t to recover the session; a pre-fix file found under a day's label at capture time is moved to optionchains/_superseded/. Completed days carry optionchains/_captured/<day>.json; in-progress captures stage in optionchains/_staging/.
chain_completeness: From 2026-10-27: each underlying's chain is requested with server-side bounds (expiration_date <= capture date + 60d, strikes +/-20% of spot when known) and paginated to exhaustion (safety cap 40 x 1000 contracts; an underlying that hits it is named in _captured/<day>.json 'truncated'). Before: 5-page cap with no server bounds — heavy chains (SPY/QQQ/IWM) lost every expiry past ~39 DTE.
cadence: once per NYSE trading day inside 16:30-18:30 ET (restart-safe, idempotent per ET trading date); <=120 underlyings (CSP universe cache + open positions), exp <=60d, strikes +/-20% of spot; ~3-5MB/day raw, gzipped by the archive compressor
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): forward-only history that can never be back-bought — the human's 'start now' mandate 2026-07-04.
